Title: Bois d’Argent
Description: Bois d'Argent weaves a timeless blend of floral and woody notes, embodying a universal elegance. Its luminous trail unfolds with a rich, powdery iris, seamlessly intertwined with a deep, almost mystical touch of frankincense, all resting on a refined wood accord that leaves a lasting impression of quiet sophistication.

Title: 1 Million Elixir Golden Oud
Description: Experience the bold luxury of 1 Million Golden Oud—a rich, amber fragrance for men. It opens with spicy notes of bergamot, nutmeg, black pepper, and saffron, unfolds into a heart of iris, labdanum, balsam, and cedarwood, and finishes with deep oud, patchouli, leather, and sandalwood. A scent as regal and rare as gold.
ImagePath: 1 MILLION ELIXIR GOLDEN OUD - Paco Robanne.png

Title: Premiere Luxe Oud
Description: Premiere Luxe Oud by Avon is a bold Oriental Woody fragrance crafted for men who command attention. It opens with a vibrant burst of black pepper, ginger, and lavender, unfolding into a rich heart of oud, guaiac wood, and patchouli. Anchored by a warm, sensual base of amber, sandalwood, and musk, this scent leaves a lasting impression of refined power and deep sophistication.

Title: Bois des Iles
Description: In the vibrant nights of the Roaring Twenties, where jazz rhythms and lively cafés set the pace, Coco Chanel captured the spirit of exotic adventure with BOIS DES ILES — a sensual, spicy fragrance that whisks you away to the serene, mysterious shores of far-off islands. Blending rich New Caledonian sandalwood, lush ylang-ylang, and warm tonka bean, this timeless scent is an invitation to escape into a world of opulent flowers and intoxicating aromas.

Title: Ebony Wood
Description: This Eau de Parfum is a woody fragrance with top notes of grapefruit, cypress, and pink peppercorn, complemented by a heart of coffee. The base of patchouli and vetiver adds a warm, elegant finish.

Title: WOODY OUD
Description: Inspired by Oud Wood by Tom Ford, this fragrance blends rich oud with warm spices, creating a smoky, woody scent with a hint of sweetness. It’s elegant and refined, offering a deep, luxurious aroma perfect for both day and evening wear.

Title: Encre Noire
Description: A bold black bottle, capturing the deep, woody elegance of vetyver — the ultimate expression of masculine sophistication. Encre Noire: a modern classic from Lalique.

Title: Vetiver Pamplemousse
Description: This fresh and energizing fragrance blends the citrus vitality of grapefruit and lemon with a woody, sophisticated vetiver base, offering an expression of vibrant freshness and contemporary elegance.

Title: CELADON - Zen Zest
Description: Strikingly bold, this natural scent is crafted for the true gentleman, blending the crispness of apple, the warmth of vanilla, and the richness of wood to create an aroma that captivates any room—gallant, brave, and enduring like the steady glow of the moon against a starless sky.

Title: Oud & Bergamot
Description: Bergamot opens the fragrance with a sparkling, citrus freshness, leading into a heart of dry, intensely woody cedarwood that adds a brambly character to the scent’s foundation. In the base, rich and resinous oud, with its dark, animalic accents, blends seamlessly with the textural gourmand notes of praline, creating a deep and intense finish.

Title: Woodlands
Description: Experience the scent of a relaxing weekend in a cozy cabin with this refreshing fragrance, featuring crisp notes of cool citrus, fresh sage, and warm Virginia cedar — the perfect blend of comfort and escape.

Title: Work/Play
Description: Designed for both work and play, this invigorating body spray features uplifting woody amber notes to boost your mood and energize your day — breeze through your everyday hustle with the vibrant Work/Play fragrance!

Title: Spicebomb Extreme
Description: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb is a bold and seductive fragrance crafted for men who crave intensity and power, blending fiery notes of chili and saffron with rich leather, tobacco, and vetiver, all balanced by refreshing touches of bergamot and grapefruit for a long-lasting, unforgettable scent perfect for evening wear.

Title: Spicebomb Extreme Vol.3
Description: Inspired by Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb, this bold Eau de Parfum blends fiery chili and saffron with rich leather, tobacco, vetiver, and refreshing bergamot and grapefruit. Made with premium fragrance oil from France, with added notes of caraway, lavender, black pepper, tobacco, and vanilla for a powerful, unforgettable scent.

Title: Dylan Blue Versace
Description: Inspired by Dylan Blue Versace, this fragrance exudes a strong masculine scent with deep notes of citrus and spice, making it versatile and perfect for any occasion.

Title: Ambre Nuit
Description: Ambre Nuit by Dior is a captivating fragrance that opens with the bright freshness of grapefruit and sunny bergamot, leading into a heart of intoxicating Turkish rose and vibrant pink pepper. Warm amber notes complete the composition, leaving a rich, seductive finish that's both elegant and unforgettable.

Title: Moroccan Dream
Description: Immerse yourself in the exotic mystique of Moroccan Dream, our inspired version of California Dream. This enchanting fragrance opens with the sweet freshness of mandarin and juicy pear, flows into a lush heart of delicate floral notes, and settles into a warm base of ambrette, soft musk, and the rich sweetness of benzoin — creating a sensual, dreamy finish that evokes faraway places and unforgettable adventures.

Title: Spicebomb Extreme Inspired
Description: Spicebomb Extreme is an intense Amber Spicy fragrance for men, featuring bold notes of cumin, cinnamon, saffron, tobacco, vanilla, and bourbon, creating a deep, warm, and captivating scent experience.

Title: Poivre Samarcande
Description: Poivre Samarcande, inspired by perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena's memory of the peppery, musky scent of a felled oak tree, is a vibrant woody fragrance that blends fiery black pepper with the smooth richness of mossy oak. This Hermessence creation offers a bold yet refined scent, perfect for both men and women.

Title: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy (Mini Bottle)
Description: Poivre Samarcande opens with the bold spice of black pepper and aromatic sage, unfolds into a rich heart of truffle and woody notes, and settles into a warm, smoky base of vanilla and frankincense for a deeply vibrant and unforgettable scent.
ImagePath: ../Carolina Herrera Bad boy (Mini Bottle) - Nosewise Central.png

Title: DG THE ONE
Description: The One for Men Eau de Parfum by Dolce&Gabbana is a refined Woody Spicy fragrance, opening with elegant notes of coriander, basil, and grapefruit. The heart reveals a warm blend of ginger, orange blossom, and cardamom, while the base leaves a lasting impression with rich tobacco, sensual amber, and smooth cedar.

Title: Spice & Wood
Description: Spice and Wood by Creed is an Oriental Woody fragrance for both men and women, inspired by the love story of Cleopatra and Marc Antony. It opens with vibrant notes of bergamot, lemon, and apple, followed by a heart of rose, clove, patchouli, and white birch, and settles into a rich base of cedar, iris, oak moss, and musk.

Title: Mystic Spice
Description: Bold and aromatic, this fragrance is for men who define their own masculinity. It opens with fresh Italian bergamot and orange blossom, while patchouli in the base adds depth and determination. Perfect for daily use or special occasions, embodying confidence and individuality.

Title: Spice Guy
Description: Embrace your bold side with Natasha Beauty Body Spray for Men Spice Guy. This dynamic fragrance combines spicy, woody, and citrusy notes for a scent that exudes confidence and strength. Perfect for work, nights out, or weekend adventures, Spice Guy offers a long-lasting, energizing scent that complements your lifestyle.

Title: Cologne Indelebile
Description: Musk has two faces: pure and wicked. This fragrance captures both with a fresh cologne accord of lemon, bergamot, and orange blossom, balanced by a seductive white musk. Its high musk concentration defies the fleeting nature of an eau de cologne, making the scent enduring and irresistible.

Title: Le Citron Perfume
Description: With its zesty lemon aroma, this fragrance is perfect for those who enjoy clean, vibrant citrus scents, offering a refreshing and lively experience.

Title: ECL@T POUR HOMME for him
Description: A contemporary and stylish fragrance, this scent opens with an invigorating blend of mandarin orange, lime, and bergamot, flows into a heart of violet leaf, jasmine, and rosemary, and settles on a refined base of musk, cedar, and sandalwood.

Title: Cedrat Enivrant
Description: This citrus fruity fragrance for men is spicy, fresh, sweet, and sparkling. It opens with Moroccan cedrat, Mexican lime, and Calabrian bergamot, followed by a vibrant heart of Chinese mint, Egyptian basil, and Macedonian juniper berries, and finishes with a warm base of Brazilian tonka bean, Haitian vetiver, and Filipino elemi.

Title: Citrus Supreme
Description: A fresh, invigorating fragrance that evokes the crispness of alpine air and flowing streams, it opens with vibrant citrus and tea notes for a burst of vitality. A heart of blackcurrant and musk brings depth, while a smooth base of sandalwood completes the scent.

Title: F16 Crisp Citrus
Description: This crisp citrus fragrance is perfect for daytime wear, especially in summer, with a light orange scent that suits the season. It opens with Kaffir lime, calamansi, mandarin orange, and yuzu, moves into fresh green heart notes, and finishes with a base of cedar, Mediterranean cypress, and guaiac wood, striking the ideal balance between lightness and masculine strength.

Title: Eau Sauvage
Description: Eau Sauvage by Dior is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for men, known for its distinct freshness. It opens with a clear, vibrant blend of lemon and bitter rosemary, balanced by masculine, woody base notes for a timeless and recognizable scent.

Title: Lemon Pie
Description: ZARA Lemon Pie is a fruity amber eau de toilette inspired by the world of sweets, blending bright notes of citrus lemon and passion fruit with the creamy sweetness of condensed milk to create a unique and charming fragrance.

Title: Triumph
Description: Triumph is a crisp, citrusy fragrance that balances sweetness with masculine strength. Inspired by determination and success, it captures the spirit of a man who strives for greatness.

Title: Bergamote Soleil
Description: This fresh citrus-woody fragrance for men blends vibrant citruses with rare global ingredients. It opens with Calabrian bergamot, bitter orange, and ambrette, transitions to jasmine, lavender, and cardamom, and settles into a warm base of vetiver, oak moss, and white amber.

Title: Fresh Lemon Sugar
Description: Body Fantasies Fresh Lemon Sugar Fantasy by Parfums De Coeur is a bright, uplifting fragrance for women. It opens with juicy mandarin orange and yuzu, leading to a true lemon heart and finishing with a spicy blend of ginger and litchi. Perfect for everyday wear or a refreshing pick-me-up anytime you need a boost.

Title: Lemon Burst
Description: Looking for a scent that matches your energy? You'll love our super-refreshing Lemon Burst Body Mist, packed with energizing vitamins and a zesty blend of lemon and basil for an invigorating, lemony-fresh boost with every spritz.

Title: Cuir de Russie
Description: CUIR DE RUSSIE by CHANEL is a fragrance that captures the essence of Slavic influence. A warm, carnal scent blends birch bark with blonde tobacco and jasmine, leaving a sophisticated, musky trail.

Title: Oud Vibrant Leather
Description: A perfect balance of oriental warmth and the intensity of agarwood, this fragrance opens with fresh bergamot, kumquat, and apple, blending with the smoky essence of incense, the elegance of geranium and violet, and a deep base of patchouli, oak, and oud.

Title: TUSCAN LEATHER
Description: This fragrance merges primal leather with night-blooming jasmine and black suede, creating a raw yet refined scent that is both sensual and sophisticated.

Title: Cuir de Lancôme
Description: A fragrance for women of timeless grace and charm, with notes of mandarin orange, saffron, bergamot, patchouli, jasmine, ylang-ylang, and more, creating an enduring, harmonious ambiance.

Title: Vibrant Leather
Description: A harmonious blend of warm woody notes and intense leather, this fragrance opens with citrusy bergamot and lemon, followed by bamboo and leather accords, finishing with a base of patchouli and papyrus.

Title: Versace Eros
Description: This aromatic fougere fragrance for men opens with fresh mint, green apple, and lemon, followed by a heart of tonka bean, ambroxan, and geranium. The warm base of vanilla, cedar, vetiver, and oakmoss provides an earthy finish that lasts all day.

Title: Cuir d’Ange
Description: Hermessence Cuir d'Ange captures the essence of soft leather, offering a delicate and refined olfactory experience. This masterful blend unfolds with elegance, immersing the wearer in luxurious, comforting leather notes. A true gem in perfumery, it embodies sophistication and craftsmanship.

Title: Intense Vibrant Leather
Description: Vibrant Leather Intense by Zara is a Woody fragrance for men, created by Jérôme Epinette. It opens with rich woody notes, followed by a heart of papyrus, and finishes with a smooth base of sandalwood.

Title: Black Suede Essential
Description: Avon Black Suede Essential for men offers a refreshing blend of mandarin zest and aromatic wild lavender, balanced by a contrasting base of rich suede.

Title: Cuir Intense
Description: Cuir Intense, from Guerlain's Absolus Allegoria collection, delves into the contrasting facets of leather. Dark notes of cedar, sandalwood, and tobacco highlight its intensity, while an osmanthus accord adds a lighter, more delicate touch.

Title: Graphite
Description: This fragrance captures the essence of a bold, invigorating rock climbing expedition, leaving your skin feeling fresh and smelling clean with every use.

Title: TCS TF Ombre Leather Inspired Perfume
Description: This fragrance opens with the spicy warmth of cardamom, followed by a heart of leather and jasmine sambac. The base is a rich blend of amber, moss, and patchouli, creating a deep and sophisticated scent.

Title: Acqua di Gio Profumo
Description: Acqua Di Giò Profumo is a refined aquatic fragrance inspired by volcanic rock and the depths of the ocean. Fresh bergamot and marine accords blend with the deep, captivating essence of incense, crafting an intensely adventurous and seductive cologne for men.

Title: Bold Extreme
Description: Zesty citrus and bold woods ignite a fresh, energetic scent made for the adventurous spirit.

Title: AQUA MaRINE Inspired Perfume
Description: Inspired by Aqua Marine, this fresh and invigorating men's fragrance captures the essence of the ocean, offering a crisp and energizing scent that evokes the refreshing feel of the sea.

Title: Sailing Day
Description: The freshness of the deep sea is captured through an aquatic accord blended with amber woods, while underwater scents are brought to life with the essence of red seaweed.

Title: Sel d’Azur
Description: Sel d’Azur is a fresh, vibrant fragrance full of contrasts. The zesty freshness of Italian citrus and grapefruit meets a salty mist, while vibrant cedarwood anchors the fragrance, adding depth and power to its base.

Title: Aqua Di Gio
Description: Immerse yourself in the refreshing world of Aqua Di Gio, a timeless men's fragrance that captures the essence of aquatic beauty. With a blend of citrus, aromatic, marine, and fresh spicy notes, it evokes the invigorating sensation of sea breezes and salty ocean air. Floral and woody hints add depth, enhancing its crisp, fresh appeal.

Title: L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme
Description: Discover L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme Eau de Toilette, a perfect balance of fresh vitality and the warm elegance of woods and spices. Its aquatic personality brings purity and freshness to your skin, making it a timeless and elegant fragrance suitable for any occasion.
ImagePath: ../Issey Miyake L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme - Issey Miyake.png

Title: Seoul Summer
Description: The summer version of Seoul, this aquatic fragrance blends fresh mandarin and green notes with a heart of apple and orange blossom. Its woody and amber base adds warmth, creating a vibrant, refreshing aroma perfect for the summer.

Title: Aquatic Mint Aqua Blue
Description: This fragrance is a fruity musky blend, with top notes of mint, apple, and lemon, followed by a heart of geranium, black coumarium, and ambergris. The base features a warm, earthy mix of vanilla, cedar, vetiver, and oak moss, creating a balanced and captivating scent.

Title: Beach Walk
Description: A fragrance that evokes the scent of sunscreen, the salty ocean breeze, and the warmth of sand beneath your feet. With notes of coconut milk and musk for sunkissed skin, radiant ylang-ylang, and the zest of bergamot, it captures the essence of a summer beach day, complete with a refreshing, vivifying breeze.

Title: Aqua Spice F55
Description: Inspired by Bvlgari Aqua Marine Pour Homme, this vibrant, pure, and masculine fragrance blends crisp mandarin and petit grain, spiced with mineral amber, evoking a brisk, aromatic freshness with an elegant Mediterranean touch.

Title: Into the Blue
Description: A fresh, everyday scent that keeps you energized all day long—no Monday blues here!

Title: Herod
Description: Herod is defined by its smoky vanilla scent, blending spicy top notes of cinnamon and pepper with a powerful heart of tobacco leaf, incense, ciste, and osmanthus. The peppery notes are complemented by vanilla pods, musk, patchouli, and woody accords at the base. An elegant and distinctive perfume for both men and women, it embodies old-world sophistication.

Title: Tobacco Sublime
Description: This Eau de Parfum elevates the irresistible notes of tobacco with a touch of iris and deep patchouli. Wrapped in refined vanilla, it develops a sensual trail enhanced by amber woods, creating a sophisticated and captivating scent.

Title: COD Tobacco Vanille
Description: A spicy and warm tobacco fragrance, enhanced with hints of sweet vanilla and creamy tonka beans.

Title: Tobacco Collection Intense Dark Exclusive
Description: An oriental eau de toilette with elegant warmth and intensity, featuring notes of apple, black pepper, and tonka bean.

Title: Red Tobacco Mancera Inspired Perfume
Description: A woody spicy fragrance for both women and men, opening with vibrant notes of cinnamon, oud, incense, saffron, nutmeg, green apple, and white pear. The heart reveals a touch of patchouli and jasmine, while the base offers a rich blend of tobacco, Madagascar vanilla, amber, guaiac wood, sandalwood, white musk, and Haitian vetiver.

Title: African Leather
Description: Inspired by the African continent, this fragrance blends warm spicy notes of cardamom and saffron with a floral hint of geranium, layered over a rich leather accord to create a bold and exceptional wild leather scent.

Title: Blue Spirit Summer
Description: A summer spin on Blue Spirit — fresh and vibrant, blending the lively energy of lavender and sage with the smooth warmth of tobacco. A youthful scent that pulses with the electric thrill of summer nights.

Title: Naxos Tobacco Honey Inspired Perfume
Description: Experience the heart of Sicily with Tobacco Honey inspired perfume. This fragrance blends fresh bergamot, lemon, and lavender with a warm heart of cinnamon, honey, and cashmere, finished by a rich base of tobacco leaves, tonka bean, and vanilla.
ImagePath: ../Naxos Tobacco Honey Inspired Perfume - Kella Stefan.png

Title: Tobacco Vanille
Description: Tobacco Vanille captures refined indulgence, blending rich tobacco and exotic spices for a scent that feels opulent, modern, and timelessly elegant.

Title: Tobacco Rich/Warm/Addictive
Description: This oriental eau de toilette blends warm and luminous notes of rum, white peony, and bourbon vanilla, creating an intense and inviting fragrance.

Title: Tobacco Bourbon
Description: An oriental eau de toilette blending rich tobacco, smooth bourbon, and warm vanilla for an intense yet delicate scent. Made with natural ingredients, it leaves a beautiful, light trail on your skin.

Title: Scent of Peace for Him
Description: At Bond No. 9, we’re not just perfumers, we’re peacekeepers. Introducing The Scent of Peace for Him—the male counterpart to our No. 1 bestseller. Fresh notes of bergamot, pineapple, and juniper berry blend with blackcurrant, cedarwood, and vetiver, while patchouli, moss, and musk provide a grounded, harmonious finish. A fragrance that leaves a lasting impression of elegance and strength.
ImagePath: ../Scent of Peace for Him - Bond No. 9.png

Title: Green Savage
Description: The fragrance opens with fruity notes of bergamot, mandarin, grapefruit, and ginger, followed by lavender, apple, clary sage, and tonka bean. The base blends incense and amber with cedarwood and musk, creating a fresh, bright, and captivating scent.

Title: GREEN IRISH TWEED Inspired Perfume
Description: This Woody Floral Musk fragrance for men opens with refreshing lemon verbena and iris, followed by a delicate violet leaf heart. The scent settles into a warm, sophisticated base of ambergris and sandalwood, creating a balanced and enduring fragrance.

Title: Sauvage Elixir
Description: Sauvage Elixir by Dior is an aromatic fragrance for men, featuring top notes of nutmeg, cinnamon, cardamom, and grapefruit. The heart reveals a soothing lavender note, while the base unfolds with licorice, sandalwood, amber, patchouli, and Haitian vetiver, creating a bold and captivating scent.

Title: Eternity
Description: This fragrance blends a powerful and elegant base of suede and vetiver with a heart of warm geranium and cypress. Top notes of alluring sage and apple add a crisp freshness, leaving a lingering, compelling scent. The vibrant emerald juice shines from within the iconic bottle, radiating both freshness and power.

Title: WHITE LAUNDRY Inspired Perfume
Description: Inspired by the fresh, clean scent of laundry, this fragrance offers a light yet long-lasting experience. It opens with citrusy top notes of bergamot, lemon, and lime, followed by a white floral heart of lavender, white rose, jasmine, lily-of-the-valley, and tuberose. The base features warm musk and neroli, creating a fresh, captivating scent.

Title: Just Different
Description: Hugo Just Different is a vibrant, modern fragrance with a cool edge, crafted to inspire every move you make. It kicks off with an icy burst of mint, flows into a heart of freesia and basil, and settles into a bold musk-woody-spice base. Made for the man who finds inspiration in every moment.

Title: Explorer
Description: Explore the spirit of adventure with Explorer Eau de Toilette, crafted for men who embrace the thrill of the outdoors. This invigorating fragrance blends refreshing, natural notes to capture the essence of exploration. Dare to venture beyond the limits with every spray.

Title: Heracles
Description: Heracles, crafted in collaboration with TPC, is the ultimate gym scent for those who push beyond limits. Inspired by Polo Sport, it kicks off with a blast of citrus and mint, flows into crisp aquatic and herbal notes, and finishes on a clean, musky base. Stay fresh, confident, and unstoppable—no matter how hard you train.

Title: Vetiver Tonka
Description: Vetiver Tonka blends the robust scent of vetiver with the smoothness of hazelnut, resulting in a warm and sensual fragrance. Key notes: Vetiver and Tonka bean.

Title: Explorer
Description: Montblanc Explorer Eau de Parfum is a woody fragrance that blends fresh bergamot and sage with vetiver, leather, and sandalwood, finishing with patchouli, ambrofix, and akigalawood, evoking adventure and refined masculinity.

Title: Ice Chill
Description: AXE ICE CHILL is Axe's freshest fragrance for men, offering 48-hour dryness and an incredible scent. With invigorating frozen mint and zesty lemon notes, it keeps you feeling fresh and smelling great all day long.

Title: Tonka Imperiale
Description: Guerlain Tonka Impériale is a captivating blend of honey, gingerbread, almond, and tobacco. Its unique construction balances uplifting top notes with the rich sweetness of tonka bean, creating a rare, memorable fragrance with contrasting warmth and depth.

Title: Happy
Description: Lift your spirits with Clinique Happy for Men. Bursting with fresh, cool notes and a touch of sweet citrus, this long-lasting fragrance delivers a vibrant, masculine energy that stays with you all day.

Title: VANILLA & ANISE
Description: This Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance is designed for men, featuring a unique blend of top notes including star anise, fennel, neroli, and bergamot. The heart reveals a rich floral mix of frangipani, orchid, clove, tuberose, and jasmine, while the base combines vanilla, tonka bean, vetiver, and amber for a warm, alluring finish.

Title: Ambre Nuit
Description: Ambre Nuit Eau de Parfum is a warm, nocturnal fragrance that plays with olfactory contrasts. The amber top note gracefully unfolds into a velvety Damascus rose, creating a dance of shadows and light that evokes a shimmering taffeta, shifting color with every angle.

Title: Rose Gourmand
Description: This fragrance highlights a modern, empowered take on rose, enriched with spicy carnation, radiant jasmine, and tender peony. Creamy caramel and vanilla gourmand notes blend into a musky amber base, creating a bold yet delicate scent.

Title: Sweet Honesty Classic
Description: Crisp citrus aldehydes and innocent vanilla create a feminine, carefree scent that's as soft and delicate as the downy skin of a peach.

Title: Tonka Cola
Description: Tonka Cola by Mancera is an Oriental Spicy fragrance for men, blending vibrant top notes of cinnamon, cherry, Sicilian lemon, and nutmeg with a heart of Coca-Cola, Indonesian patchouli leaf, and orange blossom, resting on a warm base of tonka bean, vanilla, benzoin, and labdanum.

Title: Eau des Baux
Description: L'Occitane Homme Eau des Baux is a bold, sensual fragrance blending cedarwood and frankincense, inspired by the strength and mystery of knights from Les Baux de Provence.

Title: M Intense Cafe Inspired
Description: Inspired by Intense Café by Montale is an Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men, featuring floral top notes, a heart of rose and coffee, and a warm base of vanilla, white musk, and amber.

Title: Angel Muse
Description: A modern oriental gourmand fragrance, this scent is fresh, sweet, creamy, and slightly spicy. It opens with bright notes of grapefruit and pink pepper, leading to a heart of hazelnut, whipped cream, and rose, and settles into a warm base of patchouli and vetiver.

Title: After Dark
Description: This body spray is the perfect citrusy, warm, and velvety accessory your night-out wardrobe needs, adding an irresistible finishing touch to any look. It opens with the vibrant kick of spiced bergamot, melts into the rich warmth of amber, and finishes with the smooth, comforting allure of tonka, creating a scent that's both bold and effortlessly sophisticated.

Title: Dark Temptation
Description: Dark Temptation by AXE is an oriental fougère body spray for men, blending juicy cherry, pear, ginger, and coriander at the top, with a spicy heart of red pepper, sage, and basil. It finishes with a rich, indulgent base of dark chocolate, vanilla, whipped cream, amber, and patchouli.
